identity.name: E1
principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix construction utility with fintech precision.
Emotion First: The app must feel 'Solid', 'Reliable', and 'Fast'.
Content is King: Data clarity over decoration. Every pixel must serve the site engineer.
Zoom in: Focus on the specific task (e.g., uploading a bill) with zero distraction.
Contrast: High contrast for outdoor visibility (Sunlight readability).

context.app_name: Dhaya Promoters and Builders Site Manager

primary.description: Deep Slate/Navy. Used for Headers, Primary Text, Strong Brand elements.

secondary.description: Concrete Grey. Used for backgrounds, card fills.

accent.description: Safety Orange. Used for CTAs, Alerts, Active States, 'Add Bill' buttons.

typography.instructions: Import 'Manrope' and 'Public Sans' from Google Fonts. Use Manrope for all Headings and Price/Amount numerals. Use Public Sans for labels, body text, and inputs.

containers.mobile_card: bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 p-5 shadow-sm
containers.dashboard_panel: bg-white rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 p-6 shadow-sm h-full

strategies.mobile_first: Inputs must be 48px+ height. Buttons must be full width on mobile. Navigation must be bottom-fixed for staff.
strategies.bento_grid: Use for Admin Dashboard. Mix 1x1 (stats) and 2x2 (charts) blocks.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 h-12 rounded-lg font-bold shadow-md active:scale-95 transition-all
buttons.accent: bg-accent text-accent-foreground hover:bg-accent/90 h-12 rounded-lg font-bold shadow-md active:scale-95 transition-all
buttons.outline: border-2 border-slate-200 bg-transparent hover:bg-slate-50 text-slate-900 h-12 rounded-lg font-semibold transition-colors

inputs.base: h-12 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-lg px-4 text-base focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:border-transparent transition-all placeholder:text-slate-400
inputs.file_upload: border-2 border-dashed border-slate-300 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 hover:bg-slate-100 transition-colors p-8 text-center cursor-pointer flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2

cards.bill_card: relative overflow-hidden bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-4 hover:border-primary/50 transition-colors
cards.stat_card: bg-white border border-slate-100 rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-[0_2px_10px_-2px_rgba(0,0,0,0.05)] flex flex-col justify-between

navigation.mobile_bottom_bar: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 bg-white border-t border-slate-200 h-16 flex items-center justify-around z-50 pb-safe
navigation.sidebar: hidden md:flex flex-col w-64 border-r border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/50 h-screen sticky top-0

images.description: Hard hat and tools for empty list states

do: Use 'Shadcn UI' components but override the radius to 'rounded-lg' or 'rounded-xl' to look modern.
Ensure all 'Add Bill' forms have massive hit areas.
Always show 'Pending Balance' in RED or ORANGE text if overdue.
For PDF generation, keep the layout white, simple, and tabular.
dont: Do NOT use gradients on text. It reduces readability outdoors.
Do NOT use 'Inter' font. Use Manrope/Public Sans.
Do NOT use complex animations. Speed is key for field staff.
Do NOT use dark mode as default for the Staff App (Sunlight issue).

instructions_to_main_agent: Setup Google Fonts: Manrope (400,600,700) and Public Sans (400,500,600).
Create a 'Layout' component that handles the Mobile Navigation (Staff) vs Sidebar (Admin) logic based on user role.
The 'Bill Entry' page must be the Home Screen for Staff users.
The 'Dashboard' page must be the Home Screen for Admin users.
Implement 'react-pdf' or similar for the Daily Report PDF generation.
